adoptionMechanism: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption - operator ruling 2026-06-12 [evidence: worker brief gate contract]; see the PR's POM record

authority.reason: Status is proposed; only operator merge upgrades authority.

methodsUsed: Read root and planning docs: MASTER_PLAN.md, .planning/PROJECT.md, .planning/GENESIS.md, .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md, .planning/ROADMAP.md, .planning/STATE.md, .planning/existing-state.md.

evidence.supports: Product architecture, pricing, infrastructure, competition framing, deferred scope.
Core value, requirements, constraints, validation thresholds, and existing decisions.
Target user, value chain, distribution hypothesis, moat hypothesis, and scope exclusions.
Submission, official lookup, payment, webhook, admin, campaign, and compliance API surfaces.
Watchlist sensitivity, personal/research-asset concern, and brooks-history project identity.

thesis.current: CivicState sells a low-friction civic-letter workflow: researched citations, official targeting, payment, and email delivery for individual constituents.
thesis.confidence: low-to-medium [assumption: product is implemented in part, but no production demand evidence was found]

customerDefinition.primary: Individual US resident with a specific civic concern who wants help researching, drafting, routing, and sending a constituent communication.
notCustomers: Users seeking legal filings or legal advice

revenueModel.future: Priority review and organizational API access remain deferred [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md; .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md].

financialModel.reconciliation: 50 x $5 + 30 x $15 + 20 x $25 = $1,200 monthly revenue in the 100-submission validation case [assumption: illustrative model].
financialModel.reserveControls: $1,500 reserve, $2,000 warning, $500 emergency, $0.10 discrepancy flag, 150% overage pause [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md; .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md].

marketSizing.method: Bottom-up validation only: paid submissions, completion, delivery success, official response, and operator review load.
marketSizing.reason: No external market research or production usage data available in workspace-only mode.

goToMarket.firstMotion: Manual beta in a narrow geography or issue segment.
goToMarket.secondMotion: Opt-in public campaign SEO only after privacy, moderation, and deliverability are proven.

holesAndMitigations.hole: No proof users will pay $5-$25 [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/payments.ts; assumption: willingness-to-pay unvalidated].
holesAndMitigations.mitigation: Run manual beta and require Stripe test/live checkout before delivery.
holesAndMitigations.residualRisk: High; usefulness may not become paid demand.

holesAndMitigations.mitigation: Warm domain, track per-domain bounce and spam complaint rates, pause risky domains.
holesAndMitigations.residualRisk: High; official inboxes may reject platform-generated advocacy.

holesAndMitigations.hole: Official lookup coverage may fail locally.
holesAndMitigations.mitigation: Log coverage by ZIP/source and choose provider after spike.
holesAndMitigations.residualRisk: Medium; local coverage can destroy perceived value.

holesAndMitigations.hole: Legal-adjacent moderation may overwhelm a low-ticket workflow.
holesAndMitigations.mitigation: Keep narrow launch scope and measure flag/reject/edit queue depth.
holesAndMitigations.residualRisk: High; human review can erase margin.

holesAndMitigations.hole: Project identity conflict: brooks-history dispatch vs CivicState repo evidence.
holesAndMitigations.mitigation: Operator must confirm whether this is a business pitch or research asset.
holesAndMitigations.residualRisk: High; wrong framing can mislead wrk.vc dossier readers.
